steps.what: Build the estimation and hold-out tables from the inputs (same calls and random draws as the original run; asserts that the LL at the original estimates is reproduced) (needs geopandas (county adjacency from zones.shp), not in the Biogeme venv; reads county_data_*.pkl from the original folder (see input/data/raw/README.md))
reads: county_data_{est,val}.pkl (input/data/raw if rebuilt, else the original residential folder)

steps.what: input_check, part 2: compare the rebuilt tables with the provided ones (rows, column sums, largest difference); must print ALL TABLES MATCH
Log-likelihood at the article coefficients (no estimation, nothing written)
Biogeme estimation, start values = article estimates
Compare the estimates with the article (reference_estimates.csv)

notes: Observed outcome = destination PUMA, which can span several counties. The likelihood is that of the set: log P = log sum_j chosen_set_j exp(V_j) - log sum_j av_j exp(V_j), written with Biogeme's WeightedLogSumExp (exact, not approximated).

Inclusive values IV_B (zone x structure type) and IV_A (dwelling) enter as data columns, exactly as estimated (computed by r07_county_iv.py with the final zone and dwelling models). Their coefficients are lambda_B and lambda_A.
Car time under 20 min: coefficient fixed at 0 (Beta status 1); car time applies to counties other than the previous county.

Weights: expected in-area share of destination and origin, divided by its mean. The weight is written inside the log-likelihood (w ln P) so that the robust s.e. are the WESML sandwich of the article; option --biogeme-weight uses Biogeme's 'weight' formula (same estimates, different robust s.e.).
Unavailable counties (av = 0) have their variables set to 0 in the data; they never enter the likelihood.
Steps with output_provided = true can be skipped: their results are in input/data or 00_shared_data. Upstream project stages were not re-run for this package; their runtimes are not measured.
Measured here: --check 8 s, 1.0 GB; estimation about 45 s in a test run (coefficients and robust s.e. equal to the article's to 4 decimals).
Environment: Biogeme scripts and package build scripts run with ~/.venvs/biogeme/bin/python (Biogeme 3.3.5); project scripts with /opt/homebrew/anaconda3/bin/python3 (needs geopandas).
